entries.descriptionOriginal: Dust2 Prefire Trainer Learn every angle on competitive Dust2. A shootable practice board drops you into T spawn with four long routes — B Tunnels (Outside and Upper B Tunnels into the site, out to Top Mid), Mid (Suicide and Mid through Xbox and Mid Doors, across to A and out to Long Doors), A Short (Top Mid, Catwalk and up A Short onto the site, then round to B Window) and A Long (Outside Long, Long Doors and A Long onto the site, then Short and the tunnels round to Upper B Tunnels) — each pulling from a pool of authored bot positions and dealing out a fresh subset every run, so no two attempts play the same. Every bot position is a real competitive angle — and every one of them was then probed against the map's own floor and walked in-game. 3 bot difficulty presets, from passive to fully reactive Or go custom — aim, reaction speed, the bots' buy and how many bots you face are four separate dials, so you can train against bots that snap onto you but spray wide, or bots that aim perfectly but take a moment to notice you 6 weapons on the board, including the classic deagle-only drill — or just buy whatever you want from the buy menu and take it into the run Toggleable kevlar, infinite ammo, health regen on a kill, and peeking bots that wait behind cover and swing out on you as you reach the spot they're watching — all from the board, no menus The bots come at you in route order and never appear on ground you've already cleared — not behind you, not on a site you've just walked out of, and never on screen A guide line painted along the floor shows you the route and fades out right around you, so it never gets in the way of an angle RUSH — flip the MODE tab and defend A or B as a CT against a Terrorist rush played by advanced bot AI: a different split every round, flashes thrown ahead of them, and the bomb planted even while you shoot the carrier. Clear a round and the next starts, keeping your kill streak Running low on frames? Shoot the switch in the corner of the board — it drops the guide line, the decoration and the menu itself, and fields fewer bots at a time. Same routes, same angles, same scoring Die and you're straight back into the same run Clear every bot and the board shows your time, deaths, and shot count Your best time is saved per route, difficulty, and gun — and shoot HIST to see every cleared run charted over time: your time, time-to-kill, accuracy and headshot accuracy Built as a clean overlay on the real, unmodified competitive Dust2 — nothing about the map itself is touched.

entries.descriptionOriginal: Nades Hub O mapa para você treinar todas as granadas, as mesmas que os profissionais usam. Mirage, Inferno, Dust2, Overpass, Ancient, Train, Nuke, Anubis e Cache. Como funciona Você começa na arena. Atire no ícone de um mapa para escolher e atire no telão para entrar. Treino livre: cada granada tem um boneco no lugar de onde se joga, um anel onde mirar e um cartão que diz quando usar e como jogar. Execuções: as granadas de uma entrada, uma atrás da outra, valendo tempo. Prova: as granadas do TR ou do CT, sem boneco e sem anel. No fim você ganha uma nota. Filtros: escolha o que aparece no mapa: as granadas padrão, as alternativas, as suas favoritas e os tipos (smoke, flash, molotov, HE). Idiomas: PT-BR, English (UK), Español (ES) e Русский (RU), com English por padrão. Troque na engrenagem no canto superior direito do menu (J) → Idioma (Language), ou atirando nas bandeirinhas embaixo dos ícones dos mapas na arena. Tudo o que você lê é traduzido: nomes das granadas (com os callouts de cada comunidade), cartão, menu, tutorial e telões da arena. Teclas J: abre o menu (na execução, pula a granada) E no boneco: vai para o lugar exato R: o bot mostra a granada sendo jogada L: olhando para o anel de uma granada, põe ou tira das favoritas !sair no chat: sai da execução ou da prova Atualização (02/11/2026): o mapa agora tem 4 idiomas (PT-BR, English, Español e Русский). Primeira versão. Se alguma granada não cair onde deveria, comenta aqui com o mapa e o nome dela. Nades Hub The map to train every grenade, the same ones the pros use. Mirage, Inferno, Dust2, Overpass, Ancient, Train, Nuke, Anubis and Cache. How it works You start in the arena. Shoot a map icon to pick it and shoot the big screen to go in. Free practice: every grenade has a dummy where you stand, a ring where you aim and a card that says when to use it and how to throw it. Executes: all the grenades of a site take, one after another, against the clock. Test: the T or CT grenades with no dummy and no ring. You get a score at the end. Filters: choose what shows on the map: the default grenades, the alternatives, your favorites and the types (smoke, flash, molotov, HE). Languages: PT-BR, English (UK), Español (ES) and Русский (RU), English by default. Switch with the gear button at the top-right of the menu (J) → Language, or by shooting the small flags under the map icons in the arena. Everything you read is translated: grenade names (with each community's callouts), the card, the menu, the tutorial and the arena screens. Keys J: opens the menu (skips a grenade during an execute) E on a dummy: takes you to the exact spot R: a bot shows the throw L: while looking at a grenade's ring, adds it to or removes it from your favorites !sair in chat: leaves the execute or test Update (2026-11-02): the map now has 4 languages (PT-BR, English, Español and Русский). First version. If a grenade doesn't land where it should, leave a comment with the map and its name.
